title: Searchable OCR layer host
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-cli --test cli create_ocr passes; pdfxi create ocr embeds a real image, applies the OCR pipeline plan and writes an invisible searchable-text layer whose kept words extract; CREATE-008 moves to verified.
notes: Adds a JSON-backed OcrEngine, image header parsing, and an invisible-text overlay writer over create_from_image output.
